control-api.reason: The only production cloud dependency of the local-first MVP (web/mobile marketplace catalog proxy). Liveness is polled on /health so the Neon production compute autosuspends between catalog traffic; /ready is verified once per promotion. The latest registry object is a full catalog (27,242,051 bytes in current GitHub metadata), not a small pointer. PR #853 implements a conditional ETag refresh so unchanged polls can be bodyless (304); changed catalogs still require the full response. Production release verification is pending.

workflow-worker.reason: Removed from production IaC resources while the production cloud execution runtime is disabled; the definition stays for staging qualification. Reactivation is a reviewed IaC change plus fresh Restate identity provisioning (the production restate-data volume is deleted with the service).

restate.reason: Removed from production IaC resources together with workflow-worker; production never ran durable executions (runtime disabled). Reactivation re-provisions the request identity keypair via scripts/provision-restate-identity.mjs.

control-api.reason: Local-first MVP baseline has no active deployment. Activate one replica for Cloud integration; Serverless remains off because cold-start and first-request 502 behavior are not accepted without a separate sleep certification.

workflow-worker.reason: Local-first MVP baseline has no active deployment. Activate one replica with Restate for Cloud integration because the endpoint must remain registered and reachable while a Cloud test is active.

restate.reason: Local-first MVP baseline has no active deployment. The IaC definition and standby procedure preserve a Restate volume when one exists, but the current live inventory has no staging volume or mount; provision the configured 500 MB volume and a matching request identity keypair before activation if either is absent. Activate one replica for Cloud integration; sleeping during an active test would invalidate restart and registration semantics.

usageControls.zeroComputeMechanism: disconnect application sources and remove active and reactivatable nonterminal deployments while preserving service configuration and any volumes that exist; standby does not provision missing volumes
usageControls.workspaceUsageAlert: The 2026-10-03 readback confirmed the existing 5 USD soft alert and 10 USD hard limit are configured; preserve them unless the user requests a change.
usageControls.paidPlanPolicy: Keep the current 5 USD soft alert and 10 USD hard limit while the workspace contains only the Control Plane project; change thresholds only after an explicit user request.
usageControls.hardLimitBehavior: Reaching a configured hard limit stops workloads and is an availability event.
